scope: Owned baseline pilot, primary protocol, primary tests, clean protocol, clean tests and direct A01 verification; no experimental rerun for the bookkeeping repair
cpu_accounting_note: The conservative ceiling, not the recorded subtotal, also budgets unrecorded startup and direct demonstration work. Editing and TeX compilation are not scientific experiments; compilation is recorded separately in the clean record.
upper_bound_justification: Smaller budgets and integer-only time admit subsets of the original regions; deleted edges can only remove paths, and removal of an unused maximum constant coarsens regions. Relabeling C01 use as step preserves reachability. Each newly inserted state needs an enabled transition (or is one root); oracle region insertion needs a tested constraint system. Unlogged pilot small searches are bounded by their logged full searches. No exact unlogged subtotal is asserted.
downloads: No scientific inputs or tools were downloaded. Owned JSON inputs are retained. Web-reader transport bytes were not measured; no full-paper copies are redistributed.
